items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: my cousin Andrew is a great jazz collector, and he sent Joe a tape of Freddie singing years ago

ctx.x: At the beginning of “L’il Darling” he goes [scats]. But we’ve got a record of Freddie singing, “Them There Eyes” I think it is. Yes, my cousin Andrew is a great jazz collector, and he sent Joe a tape of Freddie singing years ago. I can’t remember what the occasion was, but he was quite reasonable. It was sort of like a joke I think.
